verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every Agent Server deployment ships a built-in interactive API docs endpoint at /docs, and the hosted reference pages render a live "Try it" playground for each endpoint. This is backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Assistants, Threads, Runs, Store and other endpoints. The probe's 404s were only at guessed root paths, so they don't contradict the spec at its documented location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the playground works, and evidence of runnable examples in the Python library's own API reference (not just the Agent Server HTTP API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: every deployed or locally run Agent Server ships a built-in interactive API docs endpoint
The hosted reference pages on docs.langchain.com additionally render a live "Try it" API playground per endpoint
docs.langchain.com publishes the Agent Server (LangGraph Platform runtime) OpenAPI 3.1 document
